_comment: PLAY-1004 never produces the declared shape, correction or no correction.
What that costs: two model calls for this document and nothing else. The stage
reports the document by name, the other three documents are still audited, the
command exits non-zero (R6.9), and nothing is written to the cache for it -- a
failed document is a recorded failure, not a computed artifact, and caching it
would make one bad afternoon permanent (R6.1, R5.8).
Run it twice and watch the call log: the failure is paid for again every time,
which is the honest price of not caching it.
